description: One insider's disclosed transactions (SEC Form 4), ordered by disclosure time: the event series of a copy/inverse insider model. Get the slug from get_insiders first. Two rules for backtests: act at disclosed_at (when it became public), never trade_date (up to lag_days earlier; using it is look-ahead); and only open-market trades are decisions: set open_market_only=true to drop grants, option exercises, tax withholding and gifts, and consider exclude_planned=true (pre-scheduled Rule 10b5-1 sales carry little signal; nearly all of Jeff Bezos's Amazon sales are planned). Each trade has ticker (as of disclosure), side, shares, price, value, shares_owned_after, planned, late and an sec_url. Join to get_ohlcv for prices.

open_market_only.description: true: only open-market purchases and sales (P/S).

start.description: First disclosure date YYYY-MM-DD (default: start of the plan's history).

ticker.description: Only transactions in this company, e.g. "AMZN".

name: get_insider_trades
